free_tier.stated: 10.00 GB per file (hard cap, read off the server's own the provider). No published per-user total. 'Inactive file deletion: No limit'. 'Delete never-downloaded files: After 1 days'.

retention.stated: Retention is download-triggered, not time-based: a file nobody fetches within 24 h is deleted

egress.terms: Unmetered. Files served by GET /<sha256>, Content-addressed. Served through the server's own CDN; no egress counter is exposed anywhere.

record.interface_detail: Blossom (BUD-01/02/04/06) + NIP-96. Plain HTTP PUT /upload, GET /<sha256>, HEAD /upload for preflight. Pinned by NIP-94 kind 1063 events.
record.tooling: any HTTP client. Auth is a signed nostr event (kind 24242), so a locally generated keypair is the only credential. route96 (v0l), lotus, or hzrd149/blossom clients all speak it.
record.chaining: Content-addressed by SHA-256, so a chunk-per-object scheme maps onto it natively with no index server. The hash IS the locator.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap 10 GB. Retention is download-triggered, not time-based: a file nobody fetches within 24 h is deleted. Anything in the hot working set survives indefinitely.
record.reliability_note: single volunteer operator, no SLA, no durability warranty ('Do not use this service as your only backup'). Purges never-downloaded objects after 24 h, so a write-only cold archive decays to zero.
